append.detail: Built 2026-11-10: lib/hunts/flags.ts holds five dark switches (HUNTS_ENABLED, HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED, HUNTS_REWARDS_ENABLED, HUNTS_AUTHORING_ENABLED, HUNTS_WORKER_ENABLED) on envFlag, each on only when its parent is, so a lower rung alone never opens a higher one. Listed blank in .env.example with a one-line gate; activation gate and rollback in docs/RUNBOOKS.md (Frequency Hunts switches). Not done here: synthetic legacy rows and exact-SHA staging checks are a separate step that needs the switches wired into routes (FH-014 onward); the row stays open for that.
